abstract: Protecting endangered aquatic species while sustaining farming communities can require water buyback programs that are both cost‐effective and responsive to the variability and unpredictability of drought conditions. Working in close partnership with The Nature Conservancy and the Georgia Water Planning and Policy Center, we co‐design parallel laboratory experiments and high‐stakes framed field experiments to evaluate alternative reverse auction designs. The framed field experiments involved over $650,000 in real payments to irrigators making decisions about their own fields. Results from this lab‐to‐field experimental framework show that streamflow‐based targeting improves cost‐effectiveness relative to acre‐based targeting, and that flexible contracts linking irrigation suspension to actual streamflow conditions outperform rigid contracts when commitments must be made before drought conditions are known. This study demonstrates how integrated lab and framed field experiments can be embedded within real‐world institutional settings to generate policy‐relevant evidence for agri‐environmental programs.
abstract_zh: 保护濒危水生物种与维持农业社区生计，可能需要既具成本效益又能应对干旱条件多变性和不可预测性的水回购计划。我们与大自然保护协会和佐治亚州水资源规划与政策中心密切合作，共同设计了平行实验室实验和高风险框架田野实验，以评估替代性反向拍卖设计。框架田野实验涉及超过65万美元的实际支付，用于灌溉者就其自有田地作出决策。这一从实验室到田野的实验框架结果表明，相对于基于面积的定向，基于流量的定向提高了成本效益；并且当承诺必须在干旱条件未知之前作出时，将灌溉暂停与实际流量条件挂钩的灵活合同优于刚性合同。本研究展示了如何将实验室实验与框架田野实验相结合并嵌入现实制度环境，从而为农业环境项目生成具有政策相关性的证据。
title: Reverse auctions for drought‐responsive water buybacks: Evidence from co‐designed lab and field experiments
title_zh: 干旱响应型水资源回购的反向拍卖：来自协同设计实验室与实地实验的证据

abstract: Although climate change affects countries unevenly, the structural sources of this heterogeneity and the effectiveness of adaptation remain incompletely understood. This study develops a semi-parametric varying-coefficient framework that extends the anomaly-based climate–growth model of Kahn et al. (2021), allowing the economic effects of temperature anomalies to vary continuously with countries' structural characteristics. Using an unbalanced panel of 177 countries spanning 1965–2017, we examine six potential sources of heterogeneity and identify income, baseline temperature, and agricultural dependence as the primary structural determinants of climate vulnerability. The results reveal distinct nonlinear patterns across these structural dimensions. Climate impacts exhibit a piecewise-linear relationship with income, an inverted-smirk relationship with baseline temperature, and a threshold-like relationship with agricultural dependence. Extending the analysis to joint heterogeneity further demonstrates that the effectiveness of conventional adaptation strategies is inherently state dependent. Economic development reduces climate damages primarily in economies with relatively low agricultural dependence, whereas structural transformation is most effective in relatively high-income economies. By contrast, in persistently hot and highly agriculture-dependent economies, neither strategy alone is sufficient to substantially reduce climate damages. These findings suggest that effective climate policy should adopt differentiated adaptation strategies that account for countries' structural characteristics while integrating structural transformation with measures that reduce future climatic exposure.
abstract_zh: 尽管气候变化对各国的影晌并不均衡，但这种异质性的结构性来源以及适应措施的有效性仍未得到充分理解。本研究构建了一个半参数变系数框架，扩展了Kahn等（2021）基于异常值的气候—增长模型，使温度异常的经济效应能够随各国结构特征连续变化。基于1965—2017年177个国家的不平衡面板数据，我们考察了六种潜在的异质性来源，并识别出收入、基准温度和农业依赖度是气候脆弱性的主要结构性决定因素。结果表明，这些结构维度呈现出明显的非线性模式。气候影响与收入呈分段线性关系，与基准温度呈倒微笑关系，与农业依赖度呈类阈值关系。将分析扩展至联合异质性进一步表明，传统适应策略的有效性本质上具有状态依赖性。经济发展主要在农业依赖度相对较低的经济体中减少气候损害，而结构转型在相对高收入经济体中最为有效。相比之下，在持续高温且高度依赖农业的经济体中，单一策略均不足以大幅减少气候损害。这些发现表明，有效的气候政策应采取差异化适应策略，兼顾各国结构特征，同时将结构转型与减少未来气候暴露的措施相结合。
title: Climate impacts on economic growth: Evidence on structural heterogeneity and state-dependent adaptation
title_zh: 气候对经济增长的影响：结构异质性与状态依赖型适应的证据

abstract: This paper studies how present bias affects innovation, growth, and inequality by incorporating quasi-hyperbolic discounting into a Schumpeterian growth model with heterogeneous household assets. When the intertemporal elasticity of substitution is below one, present bias reduces innovation and slows creative destruction, increasing income and consumption inequality. In the benchmark calibration, a 6.5% innovation subsidy restores innovation and growth under lump-sum financing. At the respective growth-restoring subsidy rates, lump-sum financing raises post-tax income and consumption inequality, whereas proportional income-tax financing lowers both. Neither financing method restores these measures to the matched exponential benchmark. Under lump-sum financing, present bias also raises the welfare-maximizing subsidy from 77.5% in the exponential economy to 81.6%. Thus, growth restoration does not imply distributional restoration, and the direction of the inequality effects depends on the financing method.
abstract_zh: 本文通过将准双曲贴现引入具有异质性家庭资产的熊彼特增长模型，研究现时偏差如何影响创新、增长与不平等。当跨期替代弹性低于1时，现时偏差会抑制创新并减缓创造性破坏，从而加剧收入与消费不平等。在基准校准下，6.5%的创新补贴在一次性总付融资下可恢复创新与增长。在各自可恢复增长的补贴率下，一次性总付融资会提高税后收入与消费不平等，而比例所得税融资则会降低这两类不平等。两种融资方式均无法将这些指标恢复到相匹配的指数基准水平。在一次性总付融资下，现时偏差还将福利最大化补贴从指数经济中的77.5%提高至81.6%。因此，恢复增长并不意味着恢复分配，而不平等效应的方向取决于融资方式。
title: Present bias, innovation and inequality
title_zh: 现时偏差、创新与不平等

abstract: This research investigates the impact of policy-mandated electric vehicle (EV) charging station compatibility on incentives of EV charging network investment, EV market competition and their welfare implications using a game-theoretical approach. Through a comprehensive comparative static analysis, our study uncovers non-monotonic effects of charging station compatibility regulations on firms’ competitive strategies, consumer surplus, and social welfare. Key findings reveal that stricter compatibility regulations lead efficient EV manufacturers to reduce investments, resulting in a decline in industry-wide deployment of charging stations. This compatibility-driven investment shift subsequently influences EV price competition dynamics: efficient manufacturers lower prices to capture market share, while inefficient counterparts raise prices to offset escalating charging station deployment costs. Paradoxically, our analysis demonstrates that policies imposing stricter compatibility regulations may reduce consumer surplus, despite unintentionally benefiting inefficient manufacturers. Notably, strengthening the investment advantages for efficient manufacturers consistently increases industry-wide charging station deployment while improving both consumer surplus and social welfare. The study concludes with conditional policy insights and managerial implications that characterize how alternative compatibility levels affect market outcomes and social welfare.
abstract_zh: 本研究运用博弈论方法，考察政策强制要求的电动汽车充电站兼容性对电动汽车充电网络投资激励、电动汽车市场竞争及其福利影响的作用。通过全面的比较静态分析，本研究揭示了充电站兼容性规制对企业竞争策略、消费者剩余和社会福利的非单调影响。关键发现表明，更严格的兼容性规制会促使高效率电动汽车制造商减少投资，导致全行业充电站部署下降。这种由兼容性驱动的投资变化进而影响电动汽车价格竞争动态：高效率制造商降低价格以获取市场份额，而低效率制造商则提高价格以抵消不断上升的充电站部署成本。矛盾的是，我们的分析表明，实施更严格兼容性规制的政策可能会降低消费者剩余，尽管会无意中使低效率制造商受益。值得注意的是，强化高效率制造商的投资优势会持续增加全行业充电站部署，同时改善消费者剩余和社会福利。本研究最后提出了有条件的情境化政策启示和管理启示，刻画了不同兼容性水平如何影响市场结果和社会福利。

title: The paradox of standardization: A game-theoretic analysis of EV charging station compatibility policy
title_zh: 标准化的悖论：电动汽车充电站兼容性政策的博弈论分析

abstract: The correct measurement of economic policy uncertainty (EPU) plays a critical role in many policy settings — in particular where economic policy decisions need to be taken in response to large shocks. One such large shock is armed conflict. But, counterintuitively, the standard text-based EPU index systematically declines during armed conflict periods. Using a global news corpus covering 192 countries and over 5 million articles, we show that this decline is driven not by reduced uncertainty, but by a crowding out of reporting on economics and policy. We show that a combination of topic modeling and two-way fixed effects can be used to adjust the measurement of EPU, providing a new view on political risk during armed conflict. After adjustment, the EPU aligns more closely with firm perceptions, political risk insurance, and investment during armed conflict.
abstract_zh: 经济政策不确定性（EPU）的正确测度在许多政策情境中起着关键作用——尤其是在需要针对重大冲击做出经济政策决策的情况下。武装冲突便是此类重大冲击之一。然而，与直觉相反，基于文本的标准EPU指数在武装冲突期间会系统性下降。利用覆盖192个国家、超过500万篇文章的全球新闻语料库，我们表明这种下降并非源于不确定性降低，而是源于对经济与政策报道的挤出。我们表明，将主题建模与双向固定效应相结合可用于调整EPU的测度，从而为武装冲突期间的政治风险提供新的视角。经过调整后，EPU与武装冲突期间的企业感知、政治风险保险和投资更加吻合。
title: Uncovering economic policy uncertainty during conflict
title_zh: 揭示冲突期间的经济政策不确定性

abstract: This paper revisits the exchange rate predictability of commodity currencies through the lens of market efficiency. Focusing on currencies with strong contemporaneous exposure to commodity prices, we show that changes in country-specific commodity export or import prices predict exchange rate fluctuations both in sample and out of sample. We establish four empirical facts: (i) the sign of the predictive relationship runs counter to standard risk-based explanations; (ii) predictability is concentrated at short horizons; (iii) predictability is driven by a small set of thinly traded currencies; and (iv) even sophisticated speculative traders adjust positions sluggishly in response to commodity price shocks in these currencies. Together, these findings suggest that predictability arises from the slow incorporation of information in less actively traded currencies, which is likely due to liquidity and position-building constraints, rather than from compensation for risk. The results also clarify the sources of commodity-based predictability in carry trade returns. This paper was accepted by Lukas Schmid, finance. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.07249 .
abstract_zh: 本文从市场效率的视角重新审视商品货币的汇率可预测性。聚焦于与商品价格具有强同期暴露的货币，我们表明国别商品出口或进口价格的变化在样本内和样本外均能预测汇率波动。我们确立了四个经验事实：（i）预测关系的符号与标准的基于风险的解释相悖；（ii）可预测性集中于短期期限；（iii）可预测性由少数交易清淡的货币驱动；（iv）即使是成熟的投机交易者，在面对这些货币的商品价格冲击时也会迟缓地调整头寸。综合来看，这些发现表明可预测性源于信息在交易较不活跃的货币中被缓慢纳入，这很可能归因于流动性和建仓约束，而非风险补偿。研究结果还厘清了利差交易收益中基于商品的可预测性的来源。本文由金融学编辑Lukas Schmid接收。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.07249获取。
publisher: Institute for Operations Research and the Management Sciences (INFORMS)
title: Looking Under the Hood of Commodity Currency Predictability

abstract: Two empirical patterns emerge in business-to-business settings, particularly in retail distribution channels such as grocery markets. First, linear contracts are widely observed alongside nonlinear contracts with fixed payments, despite the claimed efficiency advantages of the latter. Second, when fixed payments arise, they often flow from suppliers to retailers (slotting fees) rather than the reverse. We develop and analyze a model of multilateral bargaining in which a supplier negotiates separately with competing retailers to explain these patterns. The key mechanism is a trade-off between two distortions: under linear contracts, wholesale prices reflect bargaining power and can be either above or below the channel-profit-maximizing level, whereas under two-part tariffs, wholesale prices are set to maximize bilateral surplus independently of bargaining power but are systematically too low from an overall channel perspective because of rent shifting across relationships. As a result, neither contractual form uniformly dominates; instead, relative performance depends on how bargaining shapes gains from trade across firms. When bargaining leads to slotting fees, two-part tariffs yield higher channel profits than linear contracts, whereas when it would imply payments from retailers to suppliers, linear contracts may perform better. These findings offer a unified explanation for the persistence of linear contracts alongside two-part tariffs, the direction of fixed payments, and the conditions under which each contractual form is likely to arise. This paper was accepted by Miguel Villas-Boas, marketing. Supplemental Material: The online appendix is available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2025.03426 .
abstract_zh: 在企业对企业环境中，尤其是杂货市场等零售分销渠道中，呈现出两个经验规律。第一，尽管非线性契约（含固定支付）被认为具有效率优势，线性契约仍与非线性契约广泛并存。第二，当固定支付出现时，其方向往往是从供应商流向零售商（进场费），而非相反。我们构建并分析了一个多边讨价还价模型，其中供应商与相互竞争的零售商分别谈判，以解释这些规律。关键机制在于两种扭曲之间的权衡：在线性契约下，批发价格反映谈判力，可能高于或低于渠道利润最大化水平；而在两部定价下，批发价格被设定为独立于谈判力以最大化双边剩余，但从整体渠道视角看，由于关系间的租金转移，批发价格系统性地过低。因此，没有一种契约形式 uniformly 占优；相反，相对表现取决于讨价还价如何塑造企业间的贸易收益。当讨价还价导致进场费时，两部定价比线性契约带来更高的渠道利润；而当讨价还价意味着零售商向供应商支付时，线性契约可能表现更好。这些发现为线性契约与两部定价并存、固定支付的方向以及每种契约形式可能出现的条件提供了统一解释。本文由营销学编辑Miguel Villas-Boas接收。补充材料：在线附录见https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2025.03426。

abstract: We argue that models coming from a variety of fields, such as matching models and discrete choice models among others, share a common structure that we call matching function equilibria with partial assignment. This structure includes an aggregate matching function and a system of nonlinear equations. We provide a proof of existence and uniqueness of an equilibrium and propose an efficient algorithm to compute it. For a subclass of matching models, we also develop a new parameter-free approach for constructing the counterfactual matching equilibrium. It has the advantage of not requiring parametric estimation when computing counterfactuals. We use our procedure to analyze the impact of the elimination of the Social Security Student Benefit Program in 1982 on the marriage market in the United States. We estimate several candidate models from our general class of matching functions and select the best fitting model using information based criterion.
abstract_zh: 我们认为，来自多个领域的模型——例如匹配模型与离散选择模型等——共享一种我们称之为带有部分分配的匹配函数均衡的共同结构。该结构包含一个总量匹配函数和一个非线性方程组。我们给出了均衡存在性与唯一性的证明，并提出了一种高效的计算算法。对于匹配模型的一个子类，我们还开发了一种新的无参数方法来构建反事实匹配均衡。其优势在于，在计算反事实时无需进行参数估计。我们运用该程序分析了1982年取消社会保障学生福利计划对美国婚姻市场的影响。我们从匹配函数的一般类中估计了若干候选模型，并基于信息准则选择了拟合最优的模型。
title: Matching Function Equilibria with Partial Assignment: Existence, Uniqueness and Estimation

abstract: This paper presents quasi-experimental research examining the effect of both local and state anti-discrimination laws on sexual orientation on the labor supply and wages of lesbian, gay, and bisexual (LGB) workers. To do so, we use the American Community Survey data on household composition to infer sexual orientation and combine this with a unique panel dataset on state and local anti-discrimination laws. Leveraging variation in law implementation across localities over time and between same-sex and different-sex couples, we find that anti-discrimination laws significantly narrow gaps in labor force participation and employment for men in same-sex couples relative to men in different-sex couples, and also increase their percentile rank in the wage distribution. Our analysis reveals mostly null effects for female same-sex couples; however, in metropolitan areas these laws significantly reduce their employment compared to women in different-sex couples. One explanation for the reduced labor supply is that female same-sex couples begin to have more children in response to the laws. Finally, we present evidence that state anti-discrimination laws significantly and persistently increased support for same-sex marriage. This research shows that anti-discrimination laws can be an effective policy tool for reducing labor market inequalities across sexual orientation and improving sentiment toward LGB Americans.
title: Effect of State and Local Sexual Orientation Anti-Discrimination Laws on Labor Market Differentials

abstract: Residential electricity demand in emerging economies is rising faster than in advanced economies, driven by income growth, urbanization, and warming temperatures, yet the price reforms typically used to curb demand are often politically infeasible where electricity is subsidized. We test whether a low-cost, non-price alternative can reduce residential electricity consumption in this setting. In two randomized field experiments in Mérida and Cancún, fast-growing cities on Mexico’s Yucatán Peninsula, households received a hand-delivered flyer that compared their electricity use with that of their neighbors and listed conservation tips. Using a difference-in-differences design, we find that in the first billing period after delivery, treated households reduced consumption by 11.3% in Cancún and 9.3% in Mérida, and their bills by 18.9% and 11.0%. These estimates are robust to conditioning on baseline consumption, to using the consumption figures originally recorded in the field, and to bounds for selective attrition. In both cities, households with higher baseline consumption reduced their consumption most, in absolute and percentage terms, suggesting that utilities could target such interventions using billing data they already hold; in Cancún, households told they consumed more than their neighbors also responded more strongly. Because our samples are small and our horizon short, we interpret these effects, which lie well above the 1–2% benchmark from large U.S. trials, as a likely upper bound on what a scaled program would achieve. We argue that the scarcity of comparable evidence from the Global South is itself a policy-relevant gap.
abstract_zh: 新兴经济体的居民用电需求增速快于发达经济体，其驱动因素包括收入增长、城市化和气温升高，然而在电力享有补贴的情况下，通常用于抑制需求的价格改革往往在政治上不可行。我们检验在这一情境中，一种低成本、非价格型的替代方案能否降低居民用电量。在墨西哥尤卡坦半岛快速扩张的城市梅里达和坎昆开展的两项随机实地实验中，住户收到手工递送的单页传单，其中将其用电量与邻居的用电量进行比较，并列出节能建议。采用双重差分设计，我们发现，在传单递送后的第一个计费周期内，处理组住户在坎昆的用电量降低了11.3%，在梅里达降低了9.3%，其电费分别降低了18.9%和11.0%。这些估计在控制基线用电量、使用实地最初记录的用电量数据以及针对选择性流失设置界限的条件下均保持稳健。在两座城市中，基线用电量较高的住户用电量下降幅度最大（无论以绝对值还是百分比衡量），这表明公用事业公司可利用其已持有的计费数据来定向实施此类干预；在坎昆，被告知自身用电量高于邻居的住户反应也更强。由于我们的样本较小且观察期较短，我们将这些效应——其远高于美国大型试验1–2%的基准——解读为规模化项目可能实现效果的上限。我们认为，来自全球南方的可比证据稀缺本身就是一个与政策相关的空白。
title: Social comparison feedback and residential electricity conservation: Field experimental evidence from Mexico

abstract: This paper is the first to systematically show that intergenerational income mobility in Germany has decreased over time. We estimate intergenerational persistence for the birth cohorts 1968–1987 and find that it rises sharply for cohorts born in the late 1970s and early 1980s, after which it stabilizes at a higher level. As a step toward understanding the mechanisms behind this increase, we show that parental income has become more important for the educational outcomes of children. Moreover, we show that the increase in intergenerational persistence has coincided with a surge in cross-sectional income inequality, providing novel evidence for an “Intertemporal Great Gatsby Curve”.
abstract_zh: 本文首次系统性地表明，德国的代际收入流动性随时间推移而下降。我们估计了1968—1987年出生队列的代际持续性，发现对于20世纪70年代末和80年代初出生的队列，代际持续性急剧上升，此后稳定在较高水平。作为理解这一上升背后机制的一步，我们表明父母收入对子女教育结果的重要性有所增加。此外，我们表明代际持续性的上升与横截面收入不平等的激增同时发生，为“跨期盖茨比曲线”提供了新的证据。
title: Rising inequality, declining mobility: The evolution of intergenerational mobility in Germany
title_zh: 不平等加剧，流动性下降：德国代际流动性的演变

abstract: This study investigates the pass-through and distributional effects of electric vehicle (EV) subsidies in China, offering insights for effective environmental policy design. Using a structural demand-supply model with detailed sales and survey data, we find that EV subsidies are more than fully passed through to consumers, yet disproportionately benefit high-income buyers. This regressive distribution undermines the subsidies’ effectiveness in promoting broader EV adoption. To address this, we propose an equitable alternative subsidy model that prioritizes innovation while being progressive—redistributing resources towards low-income households. Simulations demonstrate that, under the same budget, this scheme increases both consumer and producer surplus. Manufacturers pass on a larger share of the subsidy, and price-sensitive low-income buyers gain access to larger subsidies, expanding EV sales and yielding overall welfare gains through reduced market distortions. These findings underscore how subsidy design—particularly its distributional impact—is crucial to the success of clean vehicle policies in accelerating green technology adoption and mitigating environmental externalities, providing a blueprint for equitable, welfare-enhancing policies.
abstract_zh: 本研究考察中国电动汽车补贴的传导效应与分配效应，为有效的环境政策设计提供启示。基于包含详细销售与调查数据的结构性供需模型，我们发现电动汽车补贴对消费者的传导超过完全传导，却不成比例地惠及高收入购买者。这种累退性分配削弱了补贴在促进更广泛电动汽车采用方面的有效性。为应对这一问题，我们提出一种公平的替代补贴模式，该模式在优先支持创新的同时具有累进性——将资源向低收入家庭再分配。模拟表明，在相同预算下，该方案同时增加消费者剩余与生产者剩余。制造商传导更大比例的补贴，对价格敏感的低收入购买者获得更大额度补贴，从而扩大电动汽车销量，并通过减少市场扭曲带来整体福利增益。这些发现凸显了补贴设计——尤其是其分配效应——对于清洁车辆政策在加速绿色技术采用和缓解环境外部性方面取得成功至关重要，为公平且增进福利的政策提供了蓝图。

abstract: Urban bias in resource allocation is central to development debates, yet direct evidence on differential access to capital remains limited. Using firm-level data from China, we infer the cost of capital from returns and compare urban and rural firms within the same prefecture. We find that urban firms have significantly lower returns, indicating cheaper access to capital. This gap is large for state-owned enterprises (SOEs) but negligible for nonstate firms, and is robust across specifications. The results suggest that urban bias in capital allocation is primarily driven by state-directed investment rather than private-sector constraints.
abstract_zh: 资源分配中的城市偏向是发展争论的核心议题，然而关于资本获取差异的直接证据仍然有限。本文使用中国企业层面数据，从收益中推断资本成本，并在同一地级市内比较城市与农村企业。我们发现，城市企业的收益显著更低，表明其资本获取成本更低。这一差距在国有企业（SOEs）中较大，但在非国有企业中可忽略不计，且在不同设定下均稳健。结果表明，资本配置中的城市偏向主要由国家主导的投资驱动，而非私营部门面临的约束。

abstract: Existing studies on imperfect certification typically assume exogenous quality. This paper studies endogenous quality in a duopoly with certification subject to false negatives. Firms are either strategic or bad types. We show that, without bad types, imperfect certification cannot sustain high-quality provision in pure-strategy equilibrium. Introducing bad types disciplines strategic firms into choosing high quality when investment costs are sufficiently low. Thus, adverse selection can support, rather than undermine, quality investment incentives. Beyond the direct information effect, more accurate certification may reduce welfare by triggering an inefficient quality investment race.
abstract_zh: 现有关于不完美认证的研究通常假定质量外生。本文研究存在假阴性认证的双寡头市场中内生质量问题。企业分为策略型或劣质型。我们表明，在没有劣质型的情况下，不完美认证无法在纯策略均衡中维持高质量供给。引入劣质型会在投资成本足够低时约束策略型企业选择高质量。因此，逆向选择可以支持而非削弱质量投资激励。除直接信息效应外，更准确的认证可能引发低效率的质量投资竞赛，从而降低福利。
title: Imperfect certification and endogenous quality provision
title_zh: 不完美认证与内生质量供给

abstract: Does prosocial television reduce safety concerns? Using daily municipal-level data before and after broadcasts of the Polish crime drama Ojciec Mateusz (Father Matthew), we exploit distance from Sandomierz, the town where the show is set, as a source of variation in the psychological salience of the broadcast. Reported safety concerns decline near Sandomierz the day after a broadcast, with the effect fading with distance. The effect is driven by low-violence episodes and police-substantiated reports, consistent with the show’s prosocial content improving actual safety.
abstract_zh: 亲社会电视节目能否减少安全担忧？本文利用波兰犯罪剧《Ojciec Mateusz》（《马太神父》）播出前后的市级日度数据，以距该剧故事发生地桑多梅日（Sandomierz）的距离作为播出心理显著性的变异来源。播出次日，桑多梅日附近报告的安全担忧下降，且该效应随距离增加而减弱。这一效应由低暴力剧集和经警方证实的报告所驱动，与节目亲社会内容改善实际安全状况相一致。
title: Thou shalt not fear: Crime drama and safety concerns
title_zh: 汝不可畏惧：犯罪剧与安全忧虑

abstract: We study the adjudication of water rights in international rivers. We characterize allocation rules that formalize focal principles to deal with water disputes in a basic model. Central to our analysis is a family of geometric rules that implement concatenated transfers downstream. They can be seen as formalizing Limited Territorial Sovereignty, as suggested in the Rio Declaration on Environment and Development. We apply our rules to the case of the Nile River, with a long history of disputes between downstream and upstream nations.
abstract_zh: 我们研究国际河流中的水权裁定问题。我们在一个基本模型中刻画了将焦点原则形式化以处理水资源争端的分配规则。我们分析的核心是一类在下游实施级联转移的几何规则族。这些规则可被视为对《里约环境与发展宣言》所建议的有限领土主权的形式化。我们将这些规则应用于尼罗河案例，该河流下游与上游国家之间有着悠久的争端历史。
title: The geometric adjudication of water rights in international rivers
title_zh: 国际河流水权的几何裁决

abstract: We study how news shocks affect inflation in open economies, using large oil and gas discoveries with realized production lags of at least five years as observable news about future output. Panel local projections show that discoveries raise core consumer prices over the subsequent decade, with about half the increase occurring prior to extraction. The response is driven by nontradables, while tradable and producer prices barely respond. The real exchange rate appreciates persistently and real activity expands ahead of extraction, while the current account first deteriorates and then improves as new oil comes online. The inflationary response is concentrated under inflexible exchange-rate regimes but muted under flexible ones. A three-sector New Keynesian small open economy model rationalizes these findings through competing demand and exchange rate channels, with exchange-rate policy determining which force dominates.
abstract_zh: 我们研究新闻冲击如何影响开放经济体的通货膨胀，以大型石油和天然气发现作为关于未来产出的可观测新闻，这些发现的已实现生产滞后至少五年。面板局部投影显示，这些发现会在随后十年推高核心消费价格，其中约一半的涨幅发生在开采之前。该响应由非贸易品驱动，而贸易品价格和生产者价格几乎不作出反应。实际汇率持续升值，实际经济活动在开采前扩张，而经常账户先恶化，随后随着新石油投产而改善。通胀响应集中在汇率制度不灵活的情形下，而在灵活汇率制度下则较为微弱。一个三部门新凯恩斯小型开放经济模型通过相互竞争的需求渠道和汇率渠道来解释这些发现，而汇率政策决定哪一种力量占主导。
title: News shocks and inflation: theory and evidence from large oil discoveries
title_zh: 新闻冲击与通货膨胀：来自大型石油发现的理论与证据

abstract: In panel predictive regressions with persistent covariates, coexistence of the Nickell bias and the Stambaugh bias imposes challenges for estimation and hypothesis testing. This paper introduces an innovative estimator, the Double IVX (DIVX), inspired by the IVX technique in time series. DIVX effectively removes this composite Nickell-Stambaugh bias and reinstates standard inferential procedures based on the t -statistic. This new procedure achieves unified inference across a wide range of modes of persistence in panel predictive regressions when the cross-sectional dimension and the time dimension are comparably large. Such desirable properties were unattainable by existing methods, including the popular within-group estimator. Extensive Monte Carlo simulations demonstrate the robustness of DIVX under a variety of settings. We apply DIVX to panel data for financial markets in developed economies to examine the predictability of stock returns.
abstract_zh: 在包含持续性协变量的面板预测回归中，Nickell偏差与Stambaugh偏差的共存给估计和假设检验带来了挑战。本文引入一种创新估计量——双重IVX（DIVX），其灵感来源于时间序列中的IVX技术。DIVX有效消除了这种复合的Nickell-Stambaugh偏差，并恢复了基于t统计量的标准推断程序。当横截面维度和时间维度相当大时，这一新程序在面板预测回归中实现了跨多种持续性模式的统一推断。这些理想性质是现有方法（包括流行的组内估计量）无法实现的。大量蒙特卡洛模拟证明了DIVX在各种设定下的稳健性。我们将DIVX应用于发达经济体金融市场的面板数据，以检验股票收益的可预测性。
title: Nickell meets Stambaugh: A tale of two biases in panel predictive regressions
title_zh: Nickell与Stambaugh之遇：面板预测回归中的两种偏差

abstract: Enhancing corporate carbon disclosure within supply chain networks represents a vital imperative for global climate governance, yet whether policy-driven green supply chain management fosters genuine environmental transparency remains underexplored. Using a panel of Chinese listed enterprises (2012–2024), this study exploits the staggered rollout of national Green Supply Chain Management Demonstration lists to implement a multi-period difference-in-differences design. The findings indicate that green supply chain management effectively promotes corporate carbon disclosure. This promoting effect operates through three transmission channels: green technological innovation, external reputational scrutiny from media and green investors, and government fiscal subsidies. Furthermore, downstream customer concentration weakens this impact due to proprietary cost concerns, whereas corporate digital transformation creates positive operational synergy. Crucially, the policy drives physical carbon emission reductions and mitigates future stock price crash risk, confirming substantive decarbonization rather than symbolic compliance. These findings highlight the necessity of aligning collaborative industrial environmental regulations with digital infrastructure and market-based incentives to advance supply chain transparency and corporate risk resilience.

abstract: This study examines whether ESG greenwashing and corporate tax avoidance – two distinct manifestations of corporate opportunism – operate as strategic substitutes or complements, using 9,124 Chinese firm-year observations from 2013 to 2022. Measuring greenwashing as the decoupling between ESG disclosure and ESG performance, we document a robust positive association: a one-standard-deviation increase in greenwashing is associated with a 0.66%-point wider gap between the applicable statutory and effective tax rates. Cross-sectional tests show that the complementarity is stronger among financially unconstrained firms and firms located in more marketized regions. Overall, the evidence favours the view that symbolic ESG disclosure and aggressive tax planning are complementary rather than substitute strategies, with implications for ESG verification and tax transparency in emerging markets.

abstract: This paper presents a comprehensive long‐run analysis of regional productivity convergence in Türkiye using a novel dataset combining newly compiled employment estimates with recent output estimates. The seven‐decade analysis reveals substantial productivity convergence driven by labour reallocation away from agriculture alongside within‐industry convergence. A distinctive pattern emerges: aggregate economic concentration proceeded together with productivity convergence, with distinct regional clusters forming. Furthermore, shift‐share decomposition shows industry‐mix effects persistently explain significant regional productivity variation, reflecting sustained agriculture‐other sectors productivity differences, with western regions enjoying both favourable sectoral composition and regional competitiveness advantages. From a policy perspective, agricultural productivity improvements offer significant potential for reducing regional disparities.
abstract_zh: 本文利用一个新颖的数据集，将新编制的就业估计数据与近期的产出估计数据相结合，对土耳其区域生产率收敛进行了全面的长期分析。这项跨越七十年的分析揭示了由劳动力从农业向外重新配置以及行业内部收敛所驱动的大幅生产率收敛。一个独特的模式浮现出来：总体经济集中与生产率收敛同步推进，并形成了各具特色的区域集群。此外，偏离-份额分解表明，行业结构效应持续解释了显著的区域生产率差异，反映出农业与其他部门之间持续存在的生产率差距，而西部区域则同时享有有利的部门构成和区域竞争力优势。从政策角度看，提高农业生产力为缩小区域差距提供了巨大潜力。
title: Concentration and convergence: Regional productivity in Türkiye, 1950–2020
title_zh: 集中与趋同：土耳其的区域生产率，1950–2020

abstract: The expansion of non-grain production under climate change exerts big threat to national food security. This study investigates the nonlinear effects of climate change shocks (CCS) on farmers’ non-grain production decisions (NGPD) and the moderating mechanisms of Fintech. Using data from China Land Economic Survey (CLES) during 2020–2022, we find that CCS has an “inverted U-shaped” nonlinear impact on NGPD. Fintech significantly moderates this relationship by smoothing the curve and shifting the turning point leftward. Mechanism analysis shows Fintech achieves this by enhancing farmers’ factor allocation and risk decision abilities. Furthermore, Fintech acts as an effective substitute for traditional rural finance by overcoming constraints in formal supply and informal networks. Heterogeneity analysis reveals that Fintech strengthens agricultural resilience in major grain-producing areas but has insignificant effects on agricultural entrepreneur households, warning against profit-driven capital inducing NGPD. This study offers empirical evidence for leveraging digital finance to secure agricultural planting structures.
abstract_zh: 气候变化下非粮化扩张对国家粮食安全构成重大威胁。本研究考察气候冲击（CCS）对农户非粮化生产决策（NGPD）的非线性影响及金融科技的调节机制。基于2020—2022年中国土地经济调查（CLES）数据，研究发现CCS对NGPD具有“倒U型”非线性影响。金融科技通过平滑曲线并使拐点左移显著调节这一关系。机制分析表明，金融科技通过增强农户要素配置能力和风险决策能力实现上述调节。此外，金融科技通过克服正规供给约束和非正规网络约束，成为传统农村金融的有效替代。异质性分析显示，金融科技增强了粮食主产区的农业韧性，但对农业创业型农户的影响不显著，警示需防范利润驱动型资本诱发非粮化。本研究为利用数字金融保障农业种植结构提供经验证据。

abstract: Building on a population-level natural experiment, this study identifies the causal impact of exposure to armed conflict in a combatant role on risk, ambiguity and time preferences and related field behaviors for the average adult male randomly picked from the target population. Our setting allows us to analyze the difference in preferences without confoundment by community-level effects of conflict. Those exposed exhibit higher risk tolerance, ambiguity neutrality, patience and time consistency. We also find exposure leads to an increase in entrepreneurial activity but has no significant effect on risky health behaviors, and that elevated agency partially accounts for these shifts. Taken together, these patterns indicate that combat exposure alters preferences in ways that are not inherently positive or negative for economic welfare; what matters is how such preferences are expressed. Our results suggest agency as one potential channel through which exposure shapes this expression, making it more constructive than maladaptive in this setting.
abstract_zh: 本研究基于一项人口层面的自然实验，识别了以战斗人员身份暴露于武装冲突对随机抽取自目标人群的普通成年男性在风险偏好、模糊偏好和时间偏好及相关实地行为方面的因果影响。我们的研究情境使我们能够在不受冲突的社区层面效应混淆的情况下分析偏好差异。暴露者表现出更高的风险容忍度、模糊中性、耐心和时间一致性。我们还发现，暴露导致创业活动增加，但对高风险健康行为没有显著影响，并且 agency（能动性）的提升部分解释了这些变化。综合来看，这些模式表明，战斗暴露以对经济福利并非固有积极或消极的方式改变偏好；重要的是这些偏好如何被表达。我们的结果表明，agency 是暴露塑造这种表达的一个潜在渠道，使其在此情境下更具建设性而非适应不良。
journal: Journal of Economic Behavior and Organization
source_issue: Journal of Economic Behavior & Organization, Volume 252
title: Identifying the impact of exposure to armed conflict on individual preferences and field behavior: Evidence from Turkish draft Veterans
title_zh: 识别武装冲突暴露对个人偏好与实地行为的影响：来自土耳其征兵退伍军人的证据

abstract: As international wine trade expands, reputation becomes central in markets where consumers have limited familiarity with foreign wine regions. This paper examines how region-based and brand-based reputation framings affect consumer valuation of imported wine. Using data from 1,000 urban Chinese respondents recruited through Dynata in February 2026, we analyse willingness to pay (WTP) for Hungarian Tokaji wine under alternative reputation narratives. Respondents were randomly assigned to four information treatments in a 2 × 2 design varying reputation type and China-specific contextualization, and WTP was elicited using double-bounded contingent valuation. The factorial analysis shows that brand-based framing generates higher WTP than region-based framing in the absence of China-specific contextualization. China-specific contextualization significantly increases WTP under region-based framing but has no statistically detectable effect under brand-based framing, resulting in a significant interaction between the two treatment dimensions. These findings demonstrate that the value of reputation-related information depends on both signal type and destination-market context, with implications for product differentiation and export-market communication strategies.
abstract_zh: 随着国际葡萄酒贸易的扩展，在消费者对外国产酒产区熟悉程度有限的市场中，声誉变得至关重要。本文考察基于产区和基于品牌的声誉框架如何影响消费者对进口葡萄酒的估值。我们使用2026年2月通过Dynata招募的1，000名中国城市受访者的数据，分析在不同声誉叙事下对匈牙利托卡伊葡萄酒的支付意愿（WTP）。受访者被随机分配到2×2设计中四种信息处理条件之一，该设计变化声誉类型和中国特定情境化，并采用双边界条件价值评估法引出WTP。因子分析表明，在没有中国特定情境化的情况下，基于品牌的框架比基于产区的框架产生更高的WTP。中国特定情境化在基于产区的框架下显著提高WTP，但在基于品牌的框架下没有统计上可检测的影响，导致两个处理维度之间存在显著交互作用。这些发现表明，与声誉相关的信息的价值取决于信号类型和目的地市场情境，对产品差异化和出口市场沟通策略具有启示意义。

abstract: Using modifications of Lindeberg’s interpolation technique, I propose a new identification-robust test for the structural parameter in a heteroskedastic instrumental variables model. My analysis accommodates both scenarios where the number of instruments is much larger than the sample size and scenarios with few instruments, thus making the test broadly applicable. The proposed test statistic has a limiting chi-squared distribution so long as an auxiliary parameter can be consistently estimated. This is possible with standard methods when the number of instruments is small or using machine learning methods when the intruments are high-dimensional. To improve power, a simple combination with the sup-score statistic is proposed. The flexibility of my asymptotic approach allows for higher quality first-stage estimators to be used in the construction of the test statistic which provides noticeable power improvements over existing tests, both in Monte Carlo simulations calibrated to empirical data and in an application to the returns to education. Motivated by empirical practice, I also point out that first-stage F-statistics calculated on LASSO-selected variables may be misleading indicators of identification strength.
abstract_zh: 通过对林德伯格插值技术的改进，我提出了一种用于异方差工具变量模型中结构参数的新识别稳健检验。我的分析既适用于工具数量远大于样本量的情形，也适用于工具数量较少的情形，从而使该检验具有广泛的适用性。只要辅助参数能够一致估计，所提出的检验统计量便具有极限卡方分布。当工具数量较少时，可使用标准方法实现这一点；当工具为高维时，可使用机器学习方法实现。为提高功效，提出了与sup-score统计量的一种简单组合。我的渐近方法的灵活性允许在构造检验统计量时使用更高质量的第一阶段估计量，这在基于经验数据校准的蒙特卡洛模拟中以及在教育回报率的应用中，均相较现有检验提供了显著的功效改进。受实证实践启发，我还指出，基于LASSO所选变量计算的第一阶段F统计量可能是识别强度的误导性指标。
title: An identification-and dimensionality-robust test for instrumental variables models
title_zh: 工具变量模型的识别与维度稳健检验

abstract: Since the 2000s, U.S. public pension funds have actively shifted their risky investments away from public equities and toward alternative assets like private equity and hedge funds—some much more than others. We explore a range of possible explanations for these trends and argue that beliefs about the risk-adjusted return of alternatives have played a central role. Pension beliefs are shaped by investment consultants, peers, and experience in the 1990s. Other demand-side channels related to risk-seeking motives, spending needs, and fund governance have weaker empirical support. We also consider supply-side factors and agency interpretations of the data. (JEL G11, G23, G41, H75)
abstract_zh: 自2000年代以来，美国公共养老基金积极将其风险投资从公开市场股票转向私募股权和对冲基金等另类资产——部分基金转向幅度远大于其他基金。我们探讨了这些趋势的一系列可能解释，并认为关于另类资产风险调整后回报的信念发挥了核心作用。养老基金的信念受到投资顾问、同行以及20世纪90年代经验的影响。与寻求风险动机、支出需求和基金治理相关的其他需求侧渠道获得的实证支持较弱。我们还考虑了供给侧因素以及对数据的代理理论解读。（JEL G11, G23, G41, H75）
title: The Rise of Alternatives
title_zh: 另类选择的兴起

abstract: Northvolt was one of Europe's most ambitious electric vehicle battery manufacturers and recyclers. The Group aimed to produce low-carbon and recycled lithium-ion batteries in the gigafactory Northvolt Ett located in Skellefteå, northern Sweden. Its rapid development and abrupt collapse in a seemingly favourable policy context provide a critical entry point into the political economy of Europe's decarbonisation and reindustrialisation agenda. Based on an interdisciplinary single-case study, this article reconstructs Northvolt's trajectory at multiple territorial and governance levels (across municipal, Swedish, Nordic, and European policy levels). It draws on a qualitative research framework combining documentary analysis, field visits in Sweden, and seventeen semi-structured interviews with a multi-level sample (workers, industrial actors, researchers, trade union representatives and policymakers). We show that Northvolt's arrival was embedded in a broader shift in transition governance, from sustainability-oriented goals towards geopolitical and supply-security concerns. Yet, this reframing lacked corresponding transformation of public intervention instruments, leaving limited public capacities for strategic coordination and crisis response. This article analyses how this policy architecture helped Northvolt to build financial credibility, but simultaneously failed to address the project's systemic vulnerabilities. Two potential drivers of the failure at Northvolt Ett are examined in depth: offtake-related constraints and operational misalignments. Overall, the article brings an empirical analysis of the collapse of a European battery champion to the literature on the political economy of the energy transition.
abstract_zh: Northvolt曾是欧洲最具雄心的电动汽车电池制造商和回收商之一。该集团旨在位于瑞典北部谢莱夫特奥的超级工厂Northvolt Ett生产低碳和回收锂离子电池。其在看似有利的政策背景下迅速发展并骤然崩溃，为研究欧洲脱碳和再工业化议程的政治经济学提供了关键切入点。基于一项跨学科单案例研究，本文在多个领土和治理层面（跨越市政、瑞典、北欧和欧洲政策层面）重构了Northvolt的发展轨迹。研究采用定性研究框架，结合文献分析、瑞典实地考察以及对多层次样本（工人、产业行为体、研究人员、工会代表和政策制定者）的十七次半结构化访谈。我们表明，Northvolt的到来嵌入在转型治理的更广泛转变之中，即从以可持续性为导向的目标转向地缘政治和供应安全关切。然而，这一重新框定缺乏公共干预工具的相应转变，导致公共在战略协调和危机应对方面的能力有限。本文分析了这一政策架构如何帮助Northvolt建立财务可信度，但同时未能解决该项目的系统性脆弱性。本文深入考察了Northvolt Ett失败的兩個潜在驱动因素：承购相关约束和运营错配。总体而言，本文为能源转型政治经济学文献提供了对一家欧洲电池冠军企业崩溃的实证分析。
title: The rise and fall of Northvolt: From sustainability to battery geopolitics and industrial failure in the European Nordics
title_zh: Northvolt的兴衰：从可持续性到电池地缘政治与北欧欧洲的工业失败

abstract: We examine whether lenders incorporate behavioral signals into consumer credit pricing. Exploiting regulatory credit card reforms that altered the information content of a sophisticated credit card behavior, we show that borrowers exhibiting less sophisticated credit card usage subsequently experienced significantly higher default and bankruptcy rates across multiple consumer lending products. Despite this predictive power, lenders did not price this signal ex ante. Instead, contract terms adjusted only after repayment deterioration became observable through traditional credit metrics. These findings reveal a timing gap between observing predictive behavioral information and incorporating it into pricing decisions.
abstract_zh: 我们考察贷款方是否将行为信号纳入消费信贷定价。利用改变了一种复杂信用卡行为信息含量的监管信用卡改革，我们表明，表现出较少复杂信用卡使用的借款人事后会在多种消费信贷产品中经历显著更高的违约率和破产率。尽管这一信号具有预测力，贷款方并未在事前对此进行定价。相反，合同条款仅在还款恶化通过传统信用指标变得可观察之后才进行调整。这些发现揭示了在观察到具有预测力的行为信息与将其纳入定价决策之间存在时间差。
title: Behavioral signals and credit pricing: Evidence from credit cards
title_zh: 行为信号与信贷定价：来自信用卡的证据

abstract: We study how large language model (LLM) based recommendations affect evaluations of uncertainty. We elicit certainty equivalents for (i) lotteries that share the same reduced-form winning probability but vary in cognitive demands because they are compound, and (ii) an Ellsberg-style ambiguous lottery. Across all lottery types, valuations from participants who receive LLM-based recommendations before each valuation exhibit second-order stochastic dominance relative to valuations from participants who do not. Hence, LLM-based recommendations leave mean valuations unchanged but compress the distribution, reducing the incidence of extreme valuations. Consistent with this pattern, LLM-based recommendations reduce the intensity of risk, complexity, and ambiguity aversion, while leaving the fraction of participants classified as averse unchanged.
abstract_zh: 我们研究基于大语言模型（LLM）的推荐如何影响对不确定性的评估。我们引出以下两类彩票的确定性等值：（i）具有相同简化形式中奖概率、但因复合性而在认知需求上有所不同的彩票，以及（ii）一个埃尔斯伯格风格模糊彩票。在所有彩票类型中，与未接受LLM推荐参与者的估值相比，在每次估值前接受基于LLM推荐的参与者的估值呈现二阶随机占优。因此，基于LLM的推荐使平均估值保持不变，但压缩了分布，降低了极端估值的发生率。与这一模式一致，基于LLM的推荐降低了风险厌恶、复杂性厌恶和模糊厌恶的强度，同时使被归类为厌恶的参与者比例保持不变。
title: The impact of LLM-based recommendations on decisions under uncertainty
title_zh: 基于大语言模型的推荐对不确定性下决策的影响

abstract: Teamwork is prevalent in many forms of production, but individual contributions to team output are often ambiguous. We use a large-scale online experiment with an interactive team task to investigate gender differences in claiming credit for contributions to teamwork with misaligned incentives: Team members have an incentive to exaggerate their contribution, but this harms the other team member. In this setting, we observe that men claim to have contributed more than equally contributing women. Using two further between-subject treatments, we find no evidence that gender differences in altruism or in overconfidence explain the observed gender claim-gap. Further, the gender gap is present only among high contributors, and we show that the gap is particularly pronounced for large claims, which has potentially important consequences for gender equity in labour market outcomes.
abstract_zh: 团队合作广泛存在于多种生产形式中，但个体对团队产出的贡献往往难以明确界定。我们通过一项大规模在线实验，采用互动式团队任务，研究在激励不一致情况下，个体对团队合作贡献邀功行为中的性别差异：团队成员有动机夸大自己的贡献，但这会损害其他团队成员的利益。在此情境下，我们观察到男性声称的贡献高于贡献程度相同的女性。通过另外两个被试间处理，我们未发现利他主义或过度自信方面的性别差异能够解释所观察到的性别邀功差距。此外，该性别差距仅存在于高贡献者之中，并且我们表明，这一差距在较大贡献声称中尤为显著，这对劳动力市场结果中的性别公平可能具有重要影响。
title: Borrowed plumes: the gender gap in claiming credit for teamwork
title_zh: 借来的羽毛：团队合作中功劳归属的性别差距

abstract: Amid growing emphasis on sustainable development, this study examines the role of patient capital in shaping corporate ESG performance. Using Chinese A-share listed firms from 2009 to 2023, we construct an equity-based patient capital measure capturing shareholdings of active long-term institutional investors. The results show that patient capital is significantly positively associated with ESG performance, and the findings remain robust to a range of alternative specifications and endogeneity tests. Mechanism analyses are consistent with patient capital operating through long-term support, strategic guidance and governance enhancement, corresponding to the environmental, social and governance dimensions. Further analyses reveal strong context dependence. The positive association is more pronounced in firms with stronger development foundations, innovation capacity and governance quality, but weaker in firms facing transition constraints or governance distortions. Overall, this study offers empirical evidence and policy implications for using long-term capital to support green transformation and high-quality development.
abstract_zh: 在可持续发展日益受到重视的背景下，本研究考察耐心资本在塑造企业ESG表现中的作用。基于2009年至2023年中国A股上市公司数据，我们构建了一个基于股权的耐心资本度量指标，捕捉活跃长期机构投资者的持股情况。结果表明，耐心资本与ESG表现显著正相关，且该结论在一系列替代设定和内生性检验下保持稳健。机制分析与耐心资本通过长期支持、战略引导和治理强化发挥作用相一致，分别对应环境、社会和治理维度。进一步分析揭示了较强的情境依赖性。这种正相关关系在具有更强发展基础、创新能力和治理质量的企业中更为显著，而在面临转型约束或治理扭曲的企业中则较弱。总体而言，本研究为利用长期资本支持绿色转型和高质量发展提供了经验证据和政策启示。
china_relevance_reason: 标题、摘要或元数据包含中国相关关键词
title: How does patient capital shape ESG performance? Evidence from China
title_zh: 耐心资本如何影响ESG表现？来自中国的证据

abstract: In this article, the Indonesian stock market is examined to determine whether characteristics of the semi-strong form of the Efficient Market Hypothesis (EMH) are shown, and the association of foreign direct investment (FDI) and FDI-related deregulation with stock returns is also examined. Five methods are combined in this study: an event study, the APT, DiD, panel fixed-effects models, and LASSO regression. Archival data on Indonesian listed firms for the 2013–2020 period are used. Significant abnormal returns and cumulative abnormal returns around the 2016 FDI-related deregulation are found in the event study, and the strongest significance in the treated sample is found in the (−3, +3) window. However, uniform significance is not found across parametric and non-parametric tests. Therefore, a market response is indicated, but mixed evidence on semi-strong efficiency is obtained. In all analyses, heterogeneous and generally modest relationships between FDI, macroeconomic and institutional variables, and excess returns are found across sectors, while firm size and book to market factors are found to be more consistently relevant. Within the Adaptive Market Hypothesis, the effects of FDI and deregulation are interpreted as sector-dependent, and conclusions about market efficiency should be based mainly on the timing and persistence of abnormal returns.
abstract_zh: 本文考察印度尼西亚股票市场，以判断其是否表现出半强式有效市场假说（EMH）的特征，并检验外国直接投资（FDI）及与FDI相关的放松管制与股票收益之间的关联。本研究结合了五种方法：事件研究法、套利定价理论（APT）、双重差分法（DiD）、面板固定效应模型和LASSO回归。使用2013—2020年期间印度尼西亚上市公司的档案数据。事件研究发现，在2016年与FDI相关的放松管制前后存在显著异常收益和累计异常收益，且在处理样本中，(−3, +3)窗口内的显著性最强。然而，参数检验和非参数检验并未给出一致的显著性。因此，这表明存在市场反应，但关于半强式效率获得了混合证据。在所有分析中，发现FDI、宏观经济和制度变量与超额收益之间的关系在不同部门之间具有异质性且总体温和，而公司规模和账面市值比因素则被发现具有更一致的相关性。在适应性市场假说框架内，FDI和放松管制的效应被解释为依赖于部门，而关于市场效率的结论应主要基于异常收益的时点和持续性。
title: Foreign direct investment, deregulation, and stock market efficiency: evidence from the Indonesian capital market
title_zh: 外国直接投资、放松管制与股票市场效率：来自印度尼西亚资本市场的证据

abstract: This paper examines whether the difference between equal-weighted (EW) market returns and value-weighted (VW) market returns can predict future realized volatility. Using Chinese market-level and sector-level data, the paper applies a heterogeneous autoregressive realized volatility (HAR-RV) model to test whether the market return difference contains incremental information for forecasting realized volatility. Both in-sample and out-of-sample results indicate that the return difference provides predictive information beyond the benchmark model. The predictive power mainly comes from periods in which EW returns underperform VW returns. After controlling for the corresponding negative return in each regression, the return difference retains some predictive power at the aggregate level and in selected sectors. Overall, the difference between EW and VW returns can serve as an internal market risk-state indicator for volatility forecasting.
abstract_zh: 本文考察等权（EW）市场收益与市值加权（VW）市场收益之差能否预测未来已实现波动率。基于中国市场和行业层面数据，本文采用异质自回归已实现波动率（HAR-RV）模型，检验市场收益差是否包含用于预测已实现波动率的增量信息。样本内和样本外结果均表明，该收益差提供了超越基准模型的预测信息。预测能力主要来自EW收益跑输VW收益的时期。在每次回归中控制相应的负收益后，该收益差在总体层面和部分行业中仍保留一定预测能力。总体而言，EW与VW收益之差可作为波动率预测的市场内部风险状态指标。
china_relevance_reason: 摘要明确使用中国市场层面和行业层面数据，研究对象为中国市场，属于直接相关。
title: Difference between equal-weighted and value-weighted market returns: A new predictor for realized volatility
title_zh: 等权与市值加权市场收益之差：已实现波动率的新预测因子

abstract: Could anti-redistributive sentiment have long-run roots in Red Scare-era propaganda? In the 1930s and 40s, the media mogul William Randolph Hearst espoused vehement anti-communist rhetoric in his newspapers. Fears of socialism went head-to-head with FDR’s New Deal, the first wide-scale federal spending program. Using variation in newspaper penetration across U.S. counties, I show that an increase of 10 percentage points in Hearst circulation per capita decreased support for FDR by 2.1 percentage points. I also show evidence that these effects are long run, decreasing support for public healthcare and welfare programs through the late twentieth century.
abstract_zh: 反再分配情绪是否可能根植于红色恐慌时代的宣传？在20世纪30年代和40年代，媒体大亨威廉·伦道夫·赫斯特在其报纸上宣扬激烈的反共言论。对社会主义的恐惧与罗斯福新政——首个大规模联邦支出计划——正面交锋。利用美国各县报纸渗透率的差异，我表明，赫斯特报纸人均发行量每增加10个百分点，对罗斯福的支持率下降2.1个百分点。我还提供证据表明，这些影响是长期的，直至20世纪末仍在降低对公共医疗和福利项目的支持。
title: The Effect of Red Scare Propaganda on U.S. Public Opinion: Evidence from the Newspapers of William Randolph Hearst
title_zh: 红色恐慌宣传对美国公众舆论的影响：来自威廉·伦道夫·赫斯特报纸的证据

abstract: We describe the small amount of wage information in online job posts in the U.S. and how te information that is available is systematically correlated with occupation wages, firms wages, and local labor market tightness. Only 14% of posts contain any information, and 75% of all posts are accounted for by firms with pay information in less than 5% of their posts. More than half of posts with pay information list a range that, on average, is wide, spanning 28% of the midpoint (e.g. $21-28/hr or $32,000-$42,000/yr). The lack of information is not ‘missing at random’. First, postings for high wage occupations and at high wage firms are less likely to provide any wage information, more likely to use ranges when they do, and wider ranges at that. Second, average wages in job postings are higher than workers’ wages in CPS and OES data, especially at the bottom of the wage distribution, by around 40 percent. In low wage salaried positions this jumps to 80 percent. Our results are exemplified by the top 20 posting private, which are representative of the U.S. economy, but have wage information in less than 2% of their posts, while the top 20 firms with wage information are unrepresentative of the U.S. economy.
title: Online job posts contain very little wage information
title_zh: 在线招聘信息中工资信息极少

abstract: We introduce Government Bond Market Distress Index (GMDI), a new index that tracks distress in the secondary market for government bonds. It combines the three essential dimensions: returns, volatility, and liquidity. We demonstrate its effectiveness in capturing market distress within the context of lira-denominated government bond market in Türkiye. We find that GMDI is negatively associated with economic outcomes measured by a number of real output and business sentiment indicators. The index is flexible enough to be adapted to a wide range of countries and hence could be used to quantify local government bond market distress as an alternative to sovereign credit default spreads.
title: Introducing a new Government bond market distress index: The case of Türkiye
title_zh: 引入新的政府债券市场困境指数：以土耳其为例

abstract: Whether economic incentives matter for crime is studied in a novel way, from expensive precious metal thefts by thieves stealing catalytic converters from cars. Sharp and sizable variations in the prices of precious metals embedded in converters are combined with newly assembled U.S. crime data. Precipitously fast increases in precious metal prices generated a sizeable rise in auto-part thefts, while subsequent price declines and policy responses quickly reversed this pattern. The resulting boom-and-bust dynamics provide clean evidence that prices affect crime, and for these crimes that local resale infrastructure and target availability shape both the magnitude of this effect and the effectiveness of policy response.
title: Crime and Prices:Thefts of expensive precious metals from cars
title_zh: 犯罪与价格：汽车内贵重贵金属盗窃

abstract: To strengthen land resource governance, China has established a satellite-ground integrated land use law enforcement (LULE) system, in which remote sensing imagery is used to identify potential anomalies and on-site photographs provide essential evidence for subsequent administrative inspection. However, the large-scale interpretation of on-site photographs remains highly dependent on manual inspection, resulting in substantial administrative workloads, potential inconsistency in enforcement judgments, and limited transparency in evidence interpretation. To address these challenges, the study proposes an intelligent evidence interpretation framework based on deep neural networks and a clue knowledge graph to support on-site photograph inspection in LULE. The framework establishes a hierarchical evidence-processing workflow, in which a cross-scale attention-convolution fusion (CAF) model performs preliminary scene interpretation, a positional prior-constrained object detection (PPOD) method extracts enforcement-related visual clues, and a clue knowledge graph connects these observations with land-use compliance rules for traceable reasoning. Experimental results on 102,519 real-world on-site photographs covering eight LULE scenarios in Guangdong Province demonstrate that the proposed framework substantially improves the reliability of compliance-related evidence interpretation compared with conventional scene interpretation approaches, while providing traceable evidence chains for administrative review. The proposed framework provides an intelligent evidence-processing approach that supports more efficient, consistent, transparent, and evidence-based land-use law enforcement practices.

title: Intelligent on-site photograph interpretation by coupling deep learning and a clue knowledge graph for land administration
title_zh: 面向土地管理的深度学习与线索知识图谱耦合智能现场照片解译

abstract: For a broad class of principal-agent problems, and for “almost all” specifications of the distribution of the agent’s type, any two optimal mechanisms are equivalent: conditional on each type of the agent, neither the principal nor the agent cares which mechanism is in force. Nearly-optimal mechanisms are nearly equivalent. This provides substantial reassurance about numerical analysis of mechanisms in applied work, and has important theoretical implications as well. The model allows for both adverse selection and moral hazard. The substantive assumptions are that the set of types is finite, and a separability assumption on the agent’s utility.
title: Equivalence and Near-Equivalence of Solutions to Principal-Agent Problems
title_zh: 委托-代理问题解的等价性与近似等价性

abstract: Social media has lowered the barriers to political communication, allowing politicians to reach large audiences without relying on traditional media. Yet easier access does not imply an equal distribution of attention. This column examines this distinction by linking daily data on Twitter likes and campaign contributions for US Members of Congress in 2019–2020. The market for attention is winner-takes-all: returns become substantial only when politicians go viral, and a handful of stars capture a disproportionate share of the gains. Social media has combined unusually broad access to political communication with a highly unequal distribution of attention – and of the financial returns associated with it.
authors: Johannes Böken, Mirko Draca, Nicola Mastrorocco, Arianna Ornaghi
title: The returns to viral media
title_zh: 病毒式媒体的回报

abstract: Official development assistance fell by 23% in 2025, the largest drop on record. Aid disbursements have tended to coincide with deposits in offshore banks. This column argues that once the Panama Papers raised the cost of offshore banking, part of that diversion migrated to cryptocurrency. Linking World Bank disbursements to blockchain forensics, it finds sharp, short-lived surges of anonymous crypto activity on tax-haven exchanges in the month aid arrives, implying leakage of two to six cents per aid dollar. The public ledgers that carry diverted funds also make them detectable, which argues for supervision timed to the moment the money lands.
authors: Sumit Agarwal, Peiyi Jin, Eswar Prasad, Daniel Rabetti
title: Crypto capture of foreign aid
title_zh: 外国援助的加密俘获

abstract: Protected areas are increasingly expected to secure both biodiversity and Indigenous territorial rights, but that dual mandate breaks down where the rights-holders are peoples living in isolation, who cannot be consulted, cannot sit on a management council and cannot consent to any use of their territory. In Brazil, many live in Conservation Units (CUs) rather than in regularized Indigenous Lands (ILs). While both are recognized as protected areas (PAs), only ILs are expressly designated to secure Indigenous territorial rights. Through spatial analysis of Indigenous Peoples in Isolation (IPI) records, CUs, and ILs, combined with a systematic review of CU management plans, this article demonstrates that current PA management policy is structurally unprepared to address the territorial protection demands of isolated Indigenous groups. Of the 124 IPI records analyzed, 22 (17.7%) are located exclusively within CUs, 29 (23.3%) are in areas where CUs and ILs overlap, 65 are exclusively in ILs, and eight are outside any protected area. Fifty CUs of different categories and levels of institutional governance are associated with at least one IPI record. Of these, 23 are fully protected (IUCN Categories Ia and II), and 27 are for sustainable use (IUCN Categories IV, V, and VI). Only five of the 50 CUs have specific territorial policies for IPI. These figures reveal a governance gap that existing PA management policy has systematically failed to address: the majority of CUs with IPI presence operate without any formal zoning or protocol for these populations. Addressing this gap requires stronger inter-institutional coordination between FUNAI and ICMBio, IPI-specific governance measures in CU management plans, and formal protocols to ensure territorial protection while respecting Indigenous peoples' decision to remain in isolation. Equivalent overlaps between conservation-designated areas and peoples in isolation occur in Colombia, Ecuador, Peru and Bolivia, so the mismatch identified here is structural to any country operating two territorial protection systems under two different mandates.
title: Indigenous peoples in isolation inside protected areas: Mandate mismatch and inter-institutional coordination gaps in the Brazilian Amazon
